_doc: The Atlas Journal app manifest: daily journal entries, end-to-end encrypted. Its kinds are namespaced `journal.<kind>`; on the wire (sync protocol 7, docs/decisions/0006) every one is `journal.sealed`, with opaque field tags and the real kind inside the encrypted value. Journal v1 is personal: the server never fans its ops out to another account and reads none of their fields, so nothing is public or plaintext. `journal.entry` is one entry (date, title, body, mood, tags, …), `journal.preference` one of the app's settings. Rows written before protocol 7 carry the real kind as their wire kind and stay readable until clients migrate them. Bump `version` whenever the kinds or their fields change.
name: Atlas Journal
